text.p: A stake of 6.25 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Wednesday at an average 2,613.00 roubles ($0.464) a share, up from 2,562.00 roubles at the previous auction on January 22, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Since auctions began in March 1996, 276.25 million shares, equivalent to 1.17 percent of the capital, have changed hands, the FFK said.
Prices have risen from an average 406.60 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6, 1996. Prices reached a record average 3,015.78 roubles at the auction on October 21.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.470 at 1500 GMT on Wednesday on the Russian Trading System, up from $0.440 on Tuesday.
Its American Depositary Shares were $21.85 after $22.20. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.

The next auction will be held on February 5, when 7.5 million shares in 30 lots will be offered at a price not exceeding 2,300 roubles a share. Further auctions will be held on February 12, 19 and 26.

A total of 240,000 Gazprom shares changed hands in electronic trading on Wednesday at an average 2,428.46 roubles ($0.431) a share, down from 2,568.21 roubles at the previous session on January 24, the FFK said.
